run_f_gold: run f_gold to count strings made of R, G, and B using given combination parameters
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use math.factorial instead of a manual factorial array
review_f_gold: review f_gold which computes multinomial coefficients for string combinations of R, G, and B
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that calculates the number of strings from R, G, B character combinations
